camel_example: aliyun onsmqtt AddCustomAuthPermission --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-0pp12gl0000' --PermitAction PUB_SUB --Effect ALLOW --Identity test --Topic 'test/t1'
description_en: Grants permissions on topics. You must create a parent topic in the console before you call this API operation
description_zh: 添加Topic资源授权信息，且需要在控制台提前创建一级Topic
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt add-custom-auth-permission --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp12gl0000 --identity-type USER --identity test --permit-action PUB_SUB --effect ALLOW --topic test/t1 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCustomAuthPermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The identity type. Valid values: USER and CLIENT
parameters.help_zh: 身份类型，USER: 仅用户名，CLIENT: 具体到客户端
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en: The permissions that you want to grant
parameters.name: permit_action

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow or deny access
parameters.name: effect

parameters.help_en: The topics on which you want to grant permissions. Multi-level topics and wildcard characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 授权的topic，支持mqtt多级topic与通配符
parameters.name: topic

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the request is successful

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。返回值：true：调用成功。                                  false：调用失败
